framework: SAFe 6.0 story guidance: user-voice form, 3 Cs, INVEST, acceptance criteria, iteration-sized stories

hard_requirements.rule: At least one acceptance criterion that can be verified (Given / When / Then or an observable, measurable result)
hard_requirements.why: Acceptance criteria are the 'Confirmation' in SAFe's 3 Cs. A story with no verifiable criterion cannot be accepted, whatever its score.

criteria.name: User-voice format
criteria.safe_basis: Stories name a role, an activity, and a business value: 'As a <role>, I want <activity>, so that <value>'. Enabler stories (exploration, architecture, infrastructure, compliance) may be written without the user voice but must state their type.

criteria.name: Business value
criteria.safe_basis: INVEST 'Valuable': the 'so that' clause says why the story matters to a user, customer, or stakeholder, and doesn't just restate the activity.

criteria.name: Testable acceptance criteria
criteria.safe_basis: INVEST 'Testable' and the 3 Cs 'Confirmation': each criterion is verifiable, ideally written as Given / When / Then, with no vague terms.

criteria.name: Estimable and small
criteria.safe_basis: INVEST 'Estimable' and 'Small': the story has a relative estimate on the Fibonacci-style scale and fits within one iteration. 13 points suggests splitting; more than 13 is feature-sized.

criteria.name: Clear, independent, vertically sliced
criteria.safe_basis: INVEST 'Independent' and 'Valuable': one goal per story, sliced vertically through the system rather than by technical layer, with no vague wording.
